nodes.name: ai_helper.php
nodes.summary: Google Gemini integration for customer-feedback analysis; requires config.php and posts to the generativelanguage API over raw cURL with a five-model fallback chain.
nodes.languageNotes: Procedural cURL call rather than an SDK; disables CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, and the model list here diverges from the GEMINI_MODEL constant in config.php.

nodes.name: app.js
nodes.summary: DEAD self-contained front-end clickable prototype (~1900 lines, 96 functions) backed entirely by localStorage under s94_* keys. It duplicates the real booking, payment, inventory, loyalty and chatbot UI in the PHP pages but is not referenced by any PHP template -- only assets/js/app.js is actually loaded (by footer.php).
nodes.languageNotes: A complete localStorage SPA mock; because it never calls the PHP API it has drifted from the real server-backed implementation and should not be read as authoritative business logic.

nodes.name: styles.css
nodes.summary: The one live stylesheet for the whole app, defining a soft light-gray design system via 52 :root custom properties plus responsive breakpoints. Loaded by header.php, login.php and mfa-setup.php.
nodes.languageNotes: Theming is driven entirely by CSS custom properties, so re-skinning happens in :root without touching component rules; heavily tuned with per-widget mobile overrides.

nodes.name: styles.css
nodes.summary: DEAD stray stylesheet copy -- byte-identical (MD5 B8897A23..., 35841 bytes) to the unreferenced root styles.css, not to the live assets/css/styles.css. Zero references anywhere in the PHP or HTML.
nodes.languageNotes: An earlier revision of the theme with only 4 @media breakpoints versus 10 in the live sheet, kept alive accidentally by living under an images/ directory.

nodes.name: initSampleData
nodes.summary: Seeds localStorage with the entire demo dataset (users, bookings, inventory, loyalty, feedback, sales, photos, notifications, settings, packages) on first load, making the prototype fully self-contained.

nodes.name: createWalkinBooking
nodes.summary: Creates a walk-in booking for today with walk-in status, bypassing the multi-step booking wizard entirely.

nodes.name: formatTimeAgo
nodes.summary: Converts an ISO timestamp into a short relative string such as "5m ago" for notification and activity feeds.

nodes.name: exportTableCSV
nodes.summary: Serializes table headers and rows into CSV text and triggers a client-side download through a temporary Blob URL.

nodes.name: showPage
nodes.summary: Client-side router that toggles the visible SPA page panel and invokes the matching page-specific render function, backing the multi-role demo navigation.

nodes.name: handleLogin
nodes.summary: Prototype login handler that checks credentials against the localStorage user list and falls back to accepting anything when no match is found.

nodes.name: handleRegister
nodes.summary: Prototype registration handler that appends a new user record to the localStorage user list and switches back to the login view.

nodes.name: openPackageModal
nodes.summary: Opens the package-detail modal for a chosen tier and renders its price, duration, features and inclusions.

nodes.name: showBookingStep
nodes.summary: Advances the multi-step booking wizard, populating loyalty options and booking details as each step becomes active.

nodes.name: renderCalendar
nodes.summary: Builds the month-view booking calendar grid, marking each day by availability status so clients can choose an open slot.

nodes.name: handleBookingSubmit
nodes.summary: Validates the completed booking wizard, checks earned loyalty rewards, creates the booking plus payment records and pushes notifications to the relevant roles.

nodes.name: renderClientBookings
nodes.summary: Renders the client booking table with status badges and detail/reopen actions for each of their bookings.

nodes.name: renderStaffBookings
nodes.summary: Renders the staff booking queue with derived statistics and approve, reject and complete actions.

nodes.name: approveBooking
nodes.summary: Marks a pending booking approved, updates its inventory reservation and notifies both the client and admin.

nodes.name: rejectBooking
nodes.summary: Marks a pending booking rejected, releases the reserved inventory and notifies the client.

nodes.name: completeBooking
nodes.summary: Marks a booking complete, deducts inventory, advances loyalty counters and records the sale in the sales dataset.

nodes.name: renderClientPayments
nodes.summary: Renders the client payment history, computing per-method totals and exposing the deposit and balance columns.

nodes.name: openPaymentModal
nodes.summary: Opens the payment-detail modal and resets the chosen method to Maya so its account information is shown by default.

nodes.name: togglePaymentAccountInfo
nodes.summary: Shows or hides the account-information block for the selected payment method, swapping placeholders for real details.

nodes.name: copyToClipboard
nodes.summary: Copies text to the clipboard via the async Clipboard API with a document.execCommand fallback for older browsers.

nodes.name: submitPaymentProof
nodes.summary: Validates and stores an uploaded payment-proof image in a separate localStorage key, then notifies staff that a proof awaits verification.

nodes.name: renderStaffPayments
nodes.summary: Renders the staff payment-verification queue, computing totals and surfacing pending proofs that need review.

nodes.name: filterStaffPayments
nodes.summary: Filters the staff payment queue by status and restyles the active filter buttons to match the selection.

nodes.name: openVerifyModal
nodes.summary: Opens the payment verification modal, previews the submitted proof image and resets the rejection section to its default state.

nodes.name: toggleRejectSection
nodes.summary: Expands or collapses the rejection-reason textarea and restores the confirm button state when the section closes.

nodes.name: verifyPaymentNow
nodes.summary: Verifies a payment, moves the booking to confirmed, adds the amount to sales and notifies the client and admin.

nodes.name: rejectPaymentWithReason
nodes.summary: Rejects a payment with a supplied reason, records the rejection and notifies the client of the outcome.

nodes.name: filterAdminPayments
nodes.summary: Filters the admin payment view by status while updating the active filter button styling.

nodes.name: renderAdminPayments
nodes.summary: Renders the admin-wide payment table and refreshes the aggregate statistics displayed above it.

nodes.name: renderInventory
nodes.summary: Renders the inventory table with current stock levels and inline adjust controls for each item.

nodes.name: updateInventory
nodes.summary: Applies a signed quantity change to an inventory item and persists the updated stock level.

nodes.name: addInventoryItem
nodes.summary: Adds a new inventory item from the modal form, validating required fields and re-rendering the updated list.

nodes.name: renderAdminAnalytics
nodes.summary: Builds the admin analytics dashboard, aggregating revenue and booking trends across the last six months for the charts.

nodes.name: renderAdminBookings
nodes.summary: Renders the admin booking overview table with summary statistics and management actions.

nodes.name: submitFeedback
nodes.summary: Submits a client feedback entry, running local sentiment analysis and topic detection before appending it to the feedback dataset.

nodes.name: renderClientFeedbackHistory
nodes.summary: Renders the client own-feedback history with sentiment badges and star ratings.

nodes.name: renderFeedbackAnalytics
nodes.summary: Aggregates feedback into sentiment and topic counts for the admin review panel.

nodes.name: getLoyaltyStatus
nodes.summary: Computes a client loyalty status by counting completed bookings and mapping the total onto the reward tiers.

nodes.name: renderLoyaltyCard
nodes.summary: Renders the client loyalty stamp card, filling stamps from completed bookings and hinting at the next reward.

nodes.name: renderAdminLoyalty
nodes.summary: Renders the admin loyalty overview, aggregating client counts per tier and refreshing the tier statistics.

nodes.name: showToast
nodes.summary: Displays a transient toast notification at the bottom of the screen and removes it automatically after a short delay.

nodes.name: previewPhotos
nodes.summary: Opens the event photo preview, wiring the thumbnail click handlers that drive the gallery lightbox.

nodes.name: handleFileSelect
nodes.summary: Handles photo file selection, reading the chosen files and generating object URLs for immediate preview.

nodes.name: renderClientPhotos
nodes.summary: Renders the client uploaded-photo gallery with thumbnails and preview/cancel affordances.

nodes.name: renderNotifications
nodes.summary: Renders the notifications panel, filtering entries by the current role and formatting timestamps as relative time.

nodes.name: renderProfile
nodes.summary: Renders the user profile page by populating the editable fields from the stored user record.

nodes.name: saveProfile
nodes.summary: Persists edited profile fields back to the localStorage user record and confirms the change with a toast.

nodes.name: confirmVerifyPayment
nodes.summary: Applies the selected payment verification outcome, writing the verified or rejected result to the payment record.

nodes.name: toggleChatbot
nodes.summary: Opens or closes the floating chatbot widget and surfaces its introduction message.

nodes.name: sendChatMsg
nodes.summary: Appends the user chat message, renders a typing indicator and schedules the bot reply.

nodes.name: getBotResponse
nodes.summary: Keyword-matches chat input against curated topics (greetings, pricing, location, hours, booking process, payment) to return a canned reply.

nodes.name: initDraggableChatbot
nodes.summary: Makes the floating chatbot draggable via pointer events, constraining it within the viewport and persisting its position.

nodes.name: analyzeFeedbackWithAI
nodes.summary: Sends feedback text to the Gemini generateContent API and returns a normalized array of sentiment, 1-5 score, category, summary and suggested reply, falling through a five-model list until one returns parseable JSON.
nodes.languageNotes: Extracts the JSON object from the response with a regex before json_decode because the prompt does not fully suppress markdown code fences; returns null on every failure rather than throwing.
